tibo-reset --why-openai-resets

TIBO'S EXPLANATION · NOT A FORECAST

Why does OpenAI keep resetting the limits?

Tibo says the resets began as compensation: when rapid iteration caused downtime, a misconfiguration, or an experience below the team's bar, OpenAI returned extra usage to thank people for testing an early product. They later also became a way to mark milestones and let the whole community try a new feature or model.

  1. 01

    Compensate when the product falls short

    The first resets followed broken or suboptimal experiences. Extra usage was the make-good for people who had lost working time while relying on a product still being iterated quickly.

  2. 02

    Turn milestones into usable time

    Later resets also marked growth milestones and launches. Instead of only announcing the moment, OpenAI could give everyone more usage to explore a new model or feature.

  3. 03

    Capacity and efficiency make it affordable

    In the same interview, Tibo said OpenAI planned compute years ahead and uses frontier models to optimize its serving stack. That explains how more throughput can fit the same compute envelope — not what triggers any one reset.

What this does not mean

These resets are not a fixed plan benefit, a public timetable, or proof that every outage earns one. Tibo said they are not coordinated with marketing or finance; the button is pressed when making the experience right feels warranted.

Sources source · Tibo interview · watch from 23:37 ↗ OpenAI pricing and normal usage-limit structure ↗

The motives above are Tibo's explanation in the interview. The OpenAI documentation describes plan limits and shared usage; it does not turn a goodwill reset into a promise.

    tibo-reset --faq

    Tibo reset questions

    Who is Tibo?

    Tibo is Thibault Sottiaux. His public X bio says he works on Codex and ChatGPT at OpenAI, and his @thsottiaux account frequently carries usage-limit reset news.

    What is a “Tibo reset”?

    It is the community nickname for an extra Codex or ChatGPT Work usage-limit reset announced by Tibo. It is separate from your normal account-specific reset clock.

    When is the next Codex reset?

    There is no fixed public schedule for goodwill resets. Use the live forecast for current odds and the verified timeline for historical timing.

    Does praying actually work?

    No counter can trigger an OpenAI reset. The prayer button is affectionate community parody; OpenAI decides whether and when limits change. The forecast is the data-based view.

    What time do Codex resets usually happen?

    Across all verified resets so far, none has ever landed between 1 AM and 8 AM US Pacific — that is Tibo's sleep zone. Afternoons between 10 AM and 6 PM Pacific are the busiest band, peaking in the late afternoon. It is a historical pattern, not a schedule.

    Where can I follow Tibo?

    Follow @thsottiaux on X. This page mirrors recent public posts through the same feed used by the Codex Reset radar.
